content: Claude Code skills (code.claude.com/docs/en/skills): project skills at .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md (commit to share); frontmatter name, description, allowed-tools, arguments, disable-model-invocation, context: fork, agent. Supporting scripts under skill dir referenced via ${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}/scripts/...; ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR} for project root. $ARGUMENTS / $0 for args (e.g. photo paths). Dynamic context via !`cmd`. Keep SKILL.md < 500 lines. Skills invoked as /dvd-ingest <photos>.
